description: Laminar channel flow from rest, driven by a body force (W 20 = g = 0.8 m/s2), nu = 0.1 m2/s, no-slip walls at z = 0 and 1 m (B 20 3, D 22 2), periodic in x (C 21 1). Domain filled with water (F 60 above the lid), so the free-surface schemes run as single phase. Exact solution: Fourier series (u_max steady = g H^2/(8 nu) = 1 m/s). Tests the time integration of the implicit diffusion (D 20 2) and the wall treatment. N40=3 (momentum_FC3). With the implicit diffusion the time integration of the diffusion is first order (transient error ~0.13 u_max at CFL 0.3, ~0.015 at CFL 0.03), the steady state is exact to the spatial error. Periodic in x (4 cells), default Poisson solver REEFMG (periodic halo exchange; hypre PFMG fails for this periodic channel once the rhs is not exactly zero). Errors after the implicit wall/periodic coupling and the second-order implicit diffusion (D 23 2): transient and final ~2.5e-3, the spatial error of 20 cells (was 0.13 transient).
